title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
goal: Determine whether an undirected path connects source and destination.
strategy: Traverse reachable vertices and mark them when queued. Repeated edges of a cycle cannot cause repeated exploration, and a vertex reaches itself without traversing an edge.
